LanguageData.KS.MaxSimilarTip: Maximum stacks of the same item in this storage. Off keeps vanilla hauling behavior.
LanguageData.KS.RefillUntilTip: Optional absolute limit per stack. Empty means each item's own maximum stack size. Scroll a number to adjust it by one.
LanguageData.KS.RefillFromTip: Start refilling at this percentage, then continue until nearly full. Small extra trips are skipped. 100% keeps normal top-ups.
LanguageData.KS.ReservedSimilarStackCheckingTip: Count reserved hauling jobs toward the stack limit to avoid duplicate deliveries. Default: enabled.
LanguageData.KS.ConsiderDifferentMaterialSimilarTip: Count non-stackable items of the same type, such as hats made from different materials, toward one shared stack limit. Stackable items still use their normal stacking rules. Default: enabled.
